title: Call cutting out while pitching Lazar interview

tellings.quote: Right. And the call kept cutting when I was saying that.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that while he was on a phone call pitching an interview with a man named Bob Lazar, the call kept cutting out right as he was saying it. He tells it as a strange coincidence, the sort of thing that would hint someone was listening if it meant anything at all.
